_comment: Menu blueprint for AF3. generate_menu.py turns this into AF3 skinvariables files: per-slot widget files, a 1104 submenu file, and a slot manifest. AF3 only renders widget rows on home + slots 1101-1104 (the 5-slot cap, confirmed from the skin generator). Slots 1105+ cannot show rows, so the extra providers are nested under a 1104 'More Providers' submenu instead. Each submenu provider carries its own widget rows, bound to the submenu entry by subgroup_guid + SubGroup.IsVisible. Provider IDs are TMDb watch-provider IDs, region US.
_provider_rows_comment: Rows generated for every 'provider' slot AND every submenu provider. Latest Series = newest TV on that provider; Latest Movies = newest film releases on that provider.
_full_provider_rows_comment: Top-level provider slots (Netflix, Max) get the richer set below. Submenu providers use the leaner provider_rows above to stay light.
